description: This PHP source file defines the AssignClaimController class within the OrangeHRM Claim module. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and is responsible for preparing data and the Vue component related to assigning claims, including fetching currency data and user information for rendering.

classes.name: AssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling claim assignment view. It prepares the Vue component with necessary data such as currencies and current auth user employee number.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance used to fetch currency information.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component before rendering; adds currencies and auth employee number as component props.
